products.title: Keychron Q1 HE 8K Magnetic Switch Custom Keyboard (Japan JIS Layout)
products.body_html:
The Keychron Q1 HE 8K is a 75% layout wired magnetic switch custom gaming keyboard. Featuring advanced elements such as an 8K Polling rate and 256KHz single-key scanning rate, Keychron Ultra-fast Lime Magnetic Switch, a knob design, advanced acoustic foam, and double-shot PBT keycaps, the Q1 HE 8K enhances your gaming experience and elevates your performance.

Key specs

  • Layout: 75%, ANSI
  • Connectivity: wired; 8000 Hz polling rate
  • Switches: Keychron Ultra-fast Lime Magnetic Switch; hot-swappable
  • Build: Aluminum, gasket mount
  • Magnetic switch features: Rapid Trigger, adjustable actuation 0.1 - 3.35mm
  • Keycaps: OSA double-shot PBT keycaps
  • Software: Keychron Launcher web app for key remapping and macros; works with macOS, Windows, Linux
  • Backlight: South-facing RGB LED
  • Weight: 1860g ± 10g
  • N-key rollover: Yes

What's in the box

The Fully Assembled version includes:

  • The keyboard PCB, the plate, the case, and the foams.
  • Keycaps (included Mac & Windows keycaps).
  • Adjustable-actuation-point Keychron Ultra-fast Lime Magnetic Switch.

Product details

Supports hot-swapping with Keychron Lime and Gateron Jade magnetic switches. And beyond its 8000 Hz polling rate, the Q1 HE 8K Edition is built with a double-gasket design, full-metal body, and double-shot PBT keycaps. Together, these elements enhance comfort, stability, and sound, ensuring a refined and responsive feel across every use. 

Notes

Please drop your email on "Notify Me When Available" if the product model is out of stock.

No discount codes can be used for Q1 HE 8K versions.

products.title: Keychron K3 HE Wireless Magnetic Switch Keyboard (Japan JIS Layout)
products.body_html:
The Keychron K3 HE is an ultra-slim 75% QMK wireless keyboard featuring Magnetic switches and multidevice support for Mac, Windows, and Linux.

Key specs

  • Layout: 75%
  • Connectivity: 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, wired; 1000 Hz polling rate
  • Switches: Keychron Ultra-Fast Lime Low-Profile Magnetic Switch; hot-swappable
  • Build: Aluminum + Wood, tray mount
  • Magnetic switch features: Rapid Trigger, adjustable actuation 0.2~2.9 mm
  • Keycaps: LSA double-shot PBT keycaps, non-shine-through
  • Software: works with macOS , Windows , Linux
  • Battery: 2600 mAh, up to 55 hours
  • Backlight: North-facing RGB LED
  • Weight: 580g
  • N-key rollover: Yes (wireless & wired)

Product details

The Keychron K3 HE JIS redefines magnetic keyboards with our innovative Ultra-Fast Lime low-profile magnetic switches powered by Hall Effect sensing — delivering exceptional speed and precision in an ultra-slim 75% layout. It supports 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, and wired triple connectivity. Customize effortlessly via the Keychron Launcher web app to remap keys and create macros. It includes LSA (low-profile spherical-angled) keycaps and is fully compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Japan JIS Layout Version

The K3 HE JIS version comes with a tall JIS Enter key and dedicated Japanese input keys,
offering a familiar Japanese typing layout while keeping the same ultra-slim design and
magnetic switch performance.

Product details

The Keychron J10 Ultra 8K is a 75% wireless mechanical keyboard built for high-performance work and play. It combines hot-swappable APEX switches with Cherry-profile double-shot PBT keycaps, a PP plate, and multi-layer acoustic foam for a smooth, stable, and refined typing experience. It connects via 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth 5.3, or wired USB-C, with 8K polling rate for faster response, and features a 4000 mAh battery, aluminum alloy case, and CNC knob for a premium feel. Hot-swappable and Mac/Windows-ready with onboard storage, it only takes one setup following the Keychron J10 Ultra 8K User Guide to become the keyboard that fits you best.

You can also order it on Amazon if you're in the USA.

products.title: Keychron K8 HE Wireless Magnetic Switch Custom Keyboard - All-Wood Special Edition
products.body_html:
Keychron K8 HE All-Wood Edition is a TKL wireless keyboard with magnetic switches, QMK customization, and a natural wood body with unique grain.

Key specs

  • Layout: 80% TKL, ANSI
  • Connectivity: 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth, wired; 1000 Hz polling rate
  • Switches: Gateron Double-Rail Magnetic Nebula Switch; hot-swappable
  • Build: Frame: Walnut Wood / Side Panel: CNC-Machined Aluminum
  • Magnetic switch features: Rapid Trigger, adjustable actuation 0.2–3.8 mm
  • Keycaps: OSA Double-shot PBT keycaps, not shine-through
  • Software: QMK firmware; Keychron Launcher web app for key remapping and macros; works with macOS, Windows, Linux
  • Battery: 4000 mAh, up to 110 hours
  • Backlight: North-facing RGB LED
  • Weight: 1009 g
  • N-key rollover: Yes (wireless & wired)

Product details

Crafted with a natural all-wood body, the Keychron K8 HE All-Wood Special Edition combines the warmth and character of wood with advanced magnetic switch technology in a streamlined TKL layout. Adjustable actuation, Rapid Trigger, tri-mode connectivity, and browser-based customization give you precise control for both work and play—all in a keyboard designed to feel as distinctive as it looks.

products.title: Black JuiceBox Power Bank
products.body_html:
The JuiceBox is a magnetic power bank that snaps onto the back of your phone and charges it, no cords required. It’s smaller than a wallet and light enough to forget you packed it, so it’s actually with you when your battery isn’t. With 80+ styles and colors to choose from, or a Shell you design yourself, it matches your case, your outfit or your mood.

Works with iPhone 12 and newer and Google Pixel 10 and newer. MagSafe compatible.

Why you’ll love it

  • 5,000mAh battery. Enough to fully charge most smartphones, so you make it to the end of the day no matter how it started.
  • Up to 15W magnetic wireless charging. Snap it on, no cords required. Fast, seamless and always right where you need it.
  • Up to 20W USB-C wired output. For when you really need speed. Plug in and power up fast.
  • Charge two devices at once. One wirelessly, one by cable: your phone and your earbuds, or your phone and a friend’s.
  • LED battery indicator. Press the button to check your charge anytime. No guessing, no surprises.
  • Swappable Shells. Snap-on Shells to match your Pela case. One JuiceBox, endless looks.
  • Made with purpose. The body is made with aluminum and 75% post-consumer recycled plastic.
  • Shells are made with plants, from Pela’s Flaxstic material. B Corp certified.
  • Designed in Canada. Printed in North America.

80+ styles and colors. Or make your own.

Pick from 80+ Shell styles and colors, from soft solids to bold prints, all in the same designs as Pela cases. Want something no one else has? Personalize your Shell with your own photo, artwork or name, and make your JuiceBox one of a kind.

Compatibility

Snaps securely onto iPhone 12 and newer and Google Pixel 10 and newer. It also wirelessly charges other phones and devices with Qi wireless charging, like AirPods Pro 3. Phones without a built-in magnetic module charge at a slower wireless speed. Speed depends on your phone model and the Qi wireless standard it supports.

Air Travel Friendly

Carry it on, don’t check it. Airline rules vary, so check yours before you fly.
